records.forgivenessSource: MyGolfSpy 2024 player's-distance iron test: forgiveness 9.1/10, best-in-category among ~18 irons tested (also 9.0/10 in MyGolfSpy's 2025 retest); catalog places P-770 in the tighter players-cb tier, so positioned near the top of that tier rather than at MGS's raw cross-category number.
MyGolfSpy 2024 player's-iron test: forgiveness 9.5/10 (2nd of ~22 tested, behind only Titleist T100) and best overall score in category (9.2); positioned at top of catalog's players-cb tier.

No standalone MyGolfSpy forgiveness score published; MyGolfSpy's direct T150-vs-T100 comparison found the two 'close' on forgiveness/consistency (T100 marginally tighter dispersion/lower spin variation, T150 marginally better ball-speed/carry consistency) - estimated just below T100's measured category-leading 9.6/10.

MyGolfSpy 2024 player's-distance iron test: 8th of 18 models for forgiveness (3rd for accuracy); MGS also noted tight dispersion on mishits (1.6-yard carry delta) and the lowest left-to-right dispersion among the four T-series models compared head-to-head.
MyGolfSpy 2024 player's-iron test: forgiveness 8.8/10, ranked behind only Titleist T100 (9.6) and TaylorMade P7MC (9.5) among named leaders.

MyGolfSpy 2025 game-improvement iron test: forgiveness-weighted score 8.57/10, tied 9th of the field (with Tour Edge Hot Launch E525, PXG Black Ops), behind category leader Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal (8.8). Within-GI-cohort score; positioned in the catalog's top band, which the game-improvement category warrants in absolute terms.
MyGolfSpy 2024 player's-iron test: forgiveness 9.0/10 (3rd-highest of named leaders); low overall score (7.2) was dragged down by accuracy/distance, not forgiveness.

MyGolfSpy 2025 game-improvement iron test: forgiveness 8.8/10, runner-up overall and the only iron to finish top-3 in both distance and forgiveness; tested in the Game-Improvement (not Super-Game-Improvement) category. Within-GI-cohort score, at the top of its cohort; positioned high in the catalog's top band, which the category warrants in absolute terms.
